description: This file contains support functions for rational and numeric computations, including constants initialization, comparison, scaling, and dumping internal representations for debugging. It appears to be part of a larger mathematical or scientific computation library, specifically related to rationals and numbers.

methods.name: ChangeConstants
methods.description: Initializes or recalculates various numeric constants based on the specified radix and precision, including mathematical constants like pi, e, and logarithms, as well as maximum/minimum values for integers and floating-point approximations.

methods.name: intrat
methods.description: Converts a rational number to its integer part, modifying the input in place.

methods.name: rat_equ
methods.description: Checks if two rational numbers are equal within a given precision.

methods.name: rat_ge
methods.description: Checks if one rational number is greater than or equal to another within a given precision.

methods.name: rat_gt
methods.description: Checks if one rational number is greater than another within a given precision.

methods.name: rat_le
methods.description: Checks if one rational number is less than or equal to another within a given precision.

methods.name: rat_lt
methods.description: Checks if one rational number is less than another within a given precision.

methods.name: rat_neq
methods.description: Checks if two rational numbers are not equal within a given precision.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales a rational number by a given factor, adjusting its internal representation accordingly.

methods.name: scale2pi
methods.description: Scales a rational number to the range of 0 to 2π.

methods.name: inbetween
methods.description: Clamps a rational number within a specified range.

methods.name: _dumprawrat
methods.description: Outputs the internal structure of a rational number for debugging.

methods.name: _dumprawnum
methods.description: Outputs the internal structure of a numeric value for debugging.

methods.name: _readconstants
methods.description: Reads and initializes constant numeric values from external sources.

methods.name: trimit
methods.description: Trims digits from a rational number to prevent exponential growth in calculations, improving performance.
